title: An unbiased comparison of 14 epigenetic clocks in relation to 174 incident disease outcomes

fields.title: An unbiased comparison of 14 epigenetic clocks in relation to 174 incident disease outcomes
fields.authors: Mavrommatis, C., Belsky, D. W., Ying, K., Moqri, M., Campbell, A., Richmond, A., Gladyshev, V. N., Chandra, T., McCartney, D. L., & Marioni, R. E.
fields.description: The study compared 14 epigenetic clocks against 174 incident diseases and mortality in 18,859 people over ten years. Second- and third-generation clocks outperformed first-generation clocks, with disease prediction particularly promising for respiratory and liver conditions.

descriptions.text: The study compared 14 epigenetic clocks against 174 incident diseases and mortality in 18,859 people over ten years. Second- and third-generation clocks outperformed first-generation clocks, with disease prediction particularly promising for respiratory and liver conditions.
